gui.mekck.juice_slot: Juice slot (dual purpose): vinery juice bottles merge into the juice level pool and the empty wine bottle goes back to the bottle slot (ready for the next brew); fluid buckets are drawn one per tick into the internal tank (which must be empty or hold the same fluid), and the emptied bucket goes to the return slot. Usable buckets: kaleidoscope_tavern grape / gold grape / ice grape / green grape / glow berry / sweet berry juice buckets, plus water and lava buckets. If the tank is stuck holding a foreign fluid, the dump button now also drains it.
message.mekck.tank_drained: Juice pool cleared and the internal tank was drained (its fluid was discarded)
gui.mekck.upgrade_info.gas: Nutrient usage reduced to 10% (built-in reduction from Blaze onward)
tooltip.mekck.network_pull.title: Network Pull
tooltip.mekck.network_pull.desc: Pull one batch of inputs from the ME network (requires AE2)
tooltip.mekck.auto_pull.title: Auto Refill
tooltip.mekck.auto_pull.desc: When on, inputs are pulled from the ME network automatically; click to toggle
tooltip.mekck.winery_me_order: Advertise: when on, this machine provides its recipes as ME crafting patterns
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.cold: Unlocks cold brew attack: drops ice cubes on up to 4 targets, dealing 20 freezing damage
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.cold.detail: One wave every 2 seconds; each ice cube costs 1 output-slot product as ammo (creative upgrade exempt); target type and radius are adjustable in the GUI, attacks obey redstone control
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.low_temp: Ice cube damage raised to 40; other entities within 3×3×3 of impact take 5 extra splash damage
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.low_temp.detail: Splash damage: damage dealt by the ice cube to other entities within 3×3×3 of the impact
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.frost: Ice cube direct-hit damage raised to 200, splash damage raised to 20; +1 ice cube per wave; unlocks focusing
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.dragon_frost: Ice cube direct-hit damage raised to 300, splash damage raised to 40; freezes targets for 5 seconds
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.queen: Hit targets have their AI disabled for 2 seconds
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.hypothermia: Direct hits and splash targets gain Hypothermia I (10s, stacks up to 20); at level 20 they gain Eternal Freeze
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.hypothermia.deta: Both direct hits and splash damage stack Hypothermia: each hit adds 1 level and refreshes the 10s duration
tooltip.mekck.hypothermia.desc: Hypothermia: -5% movement speed, armor and armor toughness per level
tooltip.mekck.eternal_freeze.desc: Eternal Freeze (1h): disables AI; airborne non-dragon, non-creative entities are pulled down; any damage taken becomes 2,147,483,647 freezing damage (creative players exempt); loot is rolled with a maximum random source - every chance check succeeds and counts take the upper bound (entries inside one loot pool are still picked by weight)
tooltip.mekck.cold_brew.chain: Requires the previous cold brew upgrade installed (chain: Cold Brew → Low Temp → Frost → Dragon Frost/Queen → Hypothermia)
gui.mekck.grill_order: Seasoning Order: pick a grilling recipe and flavor to batch-season skewers
tooltip.mekck.clear_sides: Clear Side Config (Set all sides to None)
tooltip.mekck.cutting_factory: An automated cutting factory that processes multiple ingredients at once
tooltip.mekck.cooking_factory: An automated cooking factory that cooks multiple dishes at once
tooltip.mekck.skewering_factory: An automated skewering factory that threads many skewers at once
tooltip.mekck.grill_factory: An automated grill factory that cooks many ingredients at once
tooltip.mekck.planting_cutting_factory: An automated factory that grows and cuts various crops
tooltip.mekck.grinding_factory: An automated grinding factory that grinds many materials at once
tooltip.mekck.ice_factory: Makes ice from water; with a Cold Brew upgrade installed, fires ice blocks to attack enemies
tooltip.mekck.universal_cutting_machine: A universal cutting machine that quickly processes all kinds of ingredients
tooltip.mekck.planting_cutting_station: A station that grows crops using nutrients and cuts them automatically
tooltip.mekck.smart_cooking_pot: A smart cooking pot that cooks dishes automatically
tooltip.mekck.smart_skewering_machine: A smart skewering machine that threads ingredients automatically
tooltip.mekck.electric_grill: A grill that cooks food using electricity
tooltip.mekck.nebula_grill_factory: A grill used by gods, where ingredients taste absolutely divine
tooltip.mekck.singularity_grill_factory: The ultimate grill powered by solar flames
block.mekck.nebula_cooking_factory: Thermal Neutron Chain Reaction Cooking Factory
tooltip.mekck.singularity_cooking_factor: The power of the stars gathers at the bottom of the pot; the corpses of gods drift in the broth; the rivers of the Nine Provinces boil within; the World Tree burns beneath the stove. Time itself is crushed and stirred into the soup, while fate slowly swirls. What returns to dust returns here; what is created creates here. This feast is for the eternal you and me
tooltip.mekck.blaze_cutting_factory: Blazing blades seal every cut in thousand-degree heat
tooltip.mekck.blaze_cooking_factory: A furnace hot enough to shape food in rolling flame
tooltip.mekck.blaze_skewering_factory: Flame licks the skewer, locking every drop of juice inside
tooltip.mekck.blaze_grill_factory: Charcoal turned to pure flame - charred outside, tender inside, in an instant
tooltip.mekck.blaze_planting_cutting_fac: Crops shoot up visibly inside a scalding nutrient mist
tooltip.mekck.blaze_grinding_factory: Ground at searing heat, fine as flying ash
tooltip.mekck.blaze_ice_factory: Frost condensed in the heart of the flame
tooltip.mekck.nebula_cutting_factory: So dense that neutrons are pressed tightly together. As the blade falls, atoms become clearly visible
tooltip.mekck.singularity_cutting_factor: A physical one-dimensional plane manifests inside. In an instant: smooth, orderly, and 9:3:1
tooltip.mekck.nebula_cooking_factory: A controllable heavy-element chain fission induced by high energy; fast neutrons are slowed by the moderator into thermal neutrons, rapidly heating food with a slightly altered flavor... (won't turn you into the Hulk)
tooltip.mekck.nebula_skewering_factory: Skewers not even neutrons can pass through
tooltip.mekck.singularity_skewering_fact: The charcoal of the Abyss, the skewers of genesis
tooltip.mekck.electric_grinding_machine: An electric machine that grinds materials using millstone recipes
tooltip.mekck.nebula_grinding_factory: Atoms are ground into quarks, and quarks into nothingness
tooltip.mekck.singularity_grinding_facto: At the singularity, matter and void are ground together into the powder of creation
tooltip.mekck.bioreactor: Converts any organic matter into energy - green and pollution-free
jei.mekck.wine_cellar.1: Usage: put vintage-able wine bottles into the 9 slots
jei.mekck.wine_cellar.2: Type a speed 1x-50x in the GUI; higher costs more power
jei.mekck.wine_cellar.3: Cells stop drawing power at the vinery cap; vintages never stack (NBT tag)
tooltip.mekck.wine_cellar: Bribe the Time Bureau to send your wine back to the past, and get a vintage nearly as old as the universe itself. They don't come cheap.
tooltip.mekck.chocolate_cannon: An offense-defense machine that bombards enemies with Ferrero chocolates: hazelnut + chocolate + milk + hazelnut cocoa paste crafts Ferrero chocolates, and installed upgrades launch them onto enemies' heads every 2 seconds
tooltip.mekck.tea_brewer: Tea brewing automation (Simply Tea integration): insert a cup + a teabag + a hot teapot to automatically brew every cup of tea (green / black / floral / chai / chorus / cocoa), no manual crafting needed
tooltip.mekck.central_kitchen: The ultimate machine: install other machines as modules to handle recipes from every machine series in one block
tooltip.mekck.sandwich_assembler: Sandwich assembly (Some Assembly Required integration): in Sample Copy mode it mass-produces the exact sandwich decoded from the sample slot; in Custom Assembly mode it builds the requested amount from 32 ordered input slots
tooltip.mekck.nut_roaster: A tasty machine that roasts nuts: hazelnuts are roasted into Roasted Hazelnuts (tastier when roasted); it also shoots roasted hazelnuts at targeted enemies from its body (projectile damage), with target type and range adjustable in the GUI
tooltip.mekck.sushi_maker: A smart cuisine board (Youkai's Homecoming link): feed cooked rice and part ingredients, it forms the sushi base and assembles sushi rolls/nigiri; check JEI cuisine recipes for parts
tooltip.mekck.average_slicer: A dedicated slicer: only executes sushi-roll slicing cutting recipes (results with _slice), 2x speed and 0.5x energy
tooltip.mekck.rice_ball_maker: All-in-one rice machine: cooks rice, then forms rice balls (Farmer's Delight cooking recipes)
tooltip.mekck.curd_maker: Simulates dark aging (Trails & Tales Delight link): turns Curd Blocks into Cheese Wheels directly, no 10-minute wait; Cherry Curd → Cherry Cheese Wheel
tooltip.mekck.dehydrator: Air-dries food (Youkai's Homecoming link): runs drying rack recipes automatically - saplings to dead bush, fresh fish to dried fish, no hanging and waiting
tooltip.mekck.fermenter: Fermentation tank automation (Youkai's Homecoming link): feed ingredients plus input fluid (soy milk / grape juice...), ferment by recipe time, output fluid and products; 16000 mb input/output tanks, pipe-friendly
tooltip.mekck.steamer: Smart steamer automation (Youkai's Homecoming link): runs steaming recipes automatically - potato to baked potato, no pot or water needed
tooltip.mekck.winery: Wine aging automation (Vinery link): a juice bottle dropped in the juice grid is poured into the level pool right away (only one juice type at a time - press dump to switch); the emptied wine bottles go to the bottle grid, spilling into the return grid when it is full, and nothing is absorbed while both are jammed. Brewing starts only when the level pool (matching type) and the ingredient grid are both satisfied. Apple wine is the exception, its juice works both as level and as an ingredient, so keep one more bottle in the ingredient grid.
tooltip.mekck.juicer: Juice automation (Vinery link): apples straight to apple juice (mashing + fermenting combined), or feed apple mash directly; either way one empty wine bottle (vinery:wine_bottle) is consumed as the carrier
tooltip.mekck.bakery_oven: Pastry baking automation (Bakery link): cake dough + jam to cupcakes/scones/cakes, no oven needed
tooltip.mekck.blender: Blending automation (Bakeries link): insert 1-9 ingredients (9 input slots), blends into cream, chocolate paste, batter and more
tooltip.mekck.cocktail_shaker: Mixology automation (Tavern link): insert 3 wines/ingredients (wines must be quality 4+), automatically shake into cocktails
tooltip.mekck.stove: Oven automation (Farm And Charm link): runs stove/oven recipes automatically - dough + water bottle to Farmer's Bread, roasted chicken, corn, strawberry cake, no fire needed
tooltip.mekck.ferrero_upgrade.coconut: Chocolate Cannon only: raises Ferrero direct-hit damage to 500
tooltip.mekck.ferrero_upgrade.reaper: Chocolate Cannon only: launches 1 extra Ferrero per attack; unlocks focusing; raises direct-hit damage to 600
tooltip.mekck.ferrero_upgrade.crispy: Chocolate Cannon only: entities hit by Ferrero lose their AI for 2 seconds; raises direct-hit damage to 700
tooltip.mekck.ferrero_upgrade.overlord_r: Chocolate Cannon only: Ferrero damage range expands from 3x3x3 to 7x7x7; raises direct-hit damage to 800
tooltip.mekck.ferrero_upgrade.gravity_fi: Chocolate Cannon only: damage type changes from explosion to anvil, killed entities skip the death animation; raises direct-hit damage to 1000
tooltip.mekck.ferrero_upgrade.chain: Requires the previous Ferrero upgrade installed (chain: Coconut → Reaper → Crispy → Overlord Reaper → Gravity Field)
message.mekck.atomic_knife.not_enough_en: Atomic Knife does not have enough energy

The 49 foods required for the Creative Upgrade have been rolled and locked for this world; restarting will not change them. Search "Creative Upgrade" in JEI to see which foods this world needs. To re-roll on every restart, set food_rotation_mode to "per_restart" in the [creative_upgrade] section of config/mekck/mekck-common.toml.
